entities.summary: Frank West Rollins was an American lawyer, banker, and Republican politician from Concord, New Hampshire. He served New Hampshire in the state's Senate and as the 47th governor from 1899 to 1901. Rollins and others founded the Society for the Protection of New Hampshire Forests in 1901, a private organization to protect the forests now known as the "Forest Society." A shelter was built in his honor at Lost River in Kinsman Notch, New Hampshire in 1912, and remains there.
